items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: Old man James was at my house, my wife's house everyday.

ctx.x: Albert Giles came from Johnson Ridge. Johnson Ridge, yeah. That's three miles below Thibodeau.
Yeah, well that's where old man James is from too I think. Yeah, man I've been writing to James.
My wife from now, my wife's people's from there.
